notes: v2.142 (2026-11-27, evening run): 141st tower 'Hat' (a warm winter beanie — green pom-pom over a red dome crown, a yellow band and a wide blue brim — a hat silhouette to demolish, 34 blocks, 4 clusters sizes 15/10/7/2, all 4 colours, no singletons, 0 canonical duplicates) completing the pair with the existing Hat co-play prompt (put your warm hat on saying 'on… on!', check it covers your ears, shake your head and look up to see it stays put, then take it off saying 'off!' and put it on your teddy too; a grown-up checks the fit, and the dressing order is coat, boots, hat, then mittens). Hat research: at 2, taking a hat OFF is the mastered half (most 2-year-olds can pull off a hat; a loose hat can go on the head from 18 months, and putting one on with help lands around 2–2.5); dressing a teddy is the low-pressure practice form, and undressing first plus the same dressing order every time is the OT-backed routine.
